title: JxMVC: A Zero-Dependency, Security-by-Default MVC Framework for Jakarta EE
description: Full-stack MVC framework for Jakarta EE 10 in a 253 kB JAR with zero third-party runtime dependencies, enforcing security-by-default through a fixed fifteen-stage request pipeline. Includes a reproducible, single-command Docker benchmark harness.
